Scene: a dark espresso bar, polished chrome machine, warm amber key light from the left, deep brown shadows.
Subject: a steel portafilter and a matte black ceramic cup on the drip tray.
Action:
0-2s: extreme close-up, a hand locks the portafilter into the machine with one firm twist.
2-6s: two thin streams of espresso begin to flow in slow motion, tiger-striped and golden, thickening as they fall.
6-8s: the streams land in the matte black ceramic cup, golden crema swirling and settling on the surface.
Camera: extreme close-up, eye level, 85mm macro lens feel, shallow depth of field, slow tilt-down following the streams, rack focus from the spout to the surface of the cup.
Lighting and texture: warm amber backlight that makes the streams glow like honey, soft reflections sliding across the chrome, fine steam.
Audio: low pump hum, liquid trickling into ceramic.
End on: the top of the matte black ceramic cup filled with dark espresso and golden crema. Clean unbranded frame.

The most common AI video prompt mistake: the whole story in one clip.

"A barista makes coffee, pours milk, serves it and smiles" → mush.
"A barista pours milk into a cup, a rosetta appears on the foam" → a shot.

One action per clip. The rest goes into the next clips.

My first AI coffee ad was boring. Every shot from the same height, the cup was white in one clip and black in the next, nothing really happened.

I didn't change the model. I changed the prompts: its own camera for each clip, one line of details for the whole video, actions by the second.

Ever had this?

A camera line in a prompt has 5 parts:

1. shot size
2. angle
3. lens
4. one move
5. where it stops

"Camera: extreme close-up at a low angle, 100mm macro feel, slow push-in, ending on a centered hero frame."

"Cinematic" and "4K" aren't camera moves. Save this.

Want AI video that doesn't look plastic? Name one main light source and where it comes from.

Not "beautiful lighting" but "warm morning light from a window on the left".

One phrase, and the shot gets depth, shadows and mood. Try it on your next prompt.
